verdicts.reason: A fills the skyscraper column with readable type, but the right edge of 'GET A GIFT', 'Christmas' and 'www.lygom.se' runs onto the busy sweater pattern. Alignment is ragged: the stars sit flush left while the copy is centred. The crop also cuts away the woman, mug and gift, so the key imagery is lost. B is a shrunken copy of the whole text block packed into the middle third: the headline, body copy, date line and URL are tiny and unreadable at this size, the top and bottom are huge empty pink areas, and the image is again just a crop of the sweater.
